goal.zh: 亲自重跑相同输入和规则，观察是否一致；再用阈值边界检查不同输入。
goal.en: Rerun identical input and rule versions, observe consistency, then test the threshold boundary.

explanation.zh: 算法是一套可执行的方法或步骤。模型训练也依照算法进行，但算法本身不是训练后得到的模型。
explanation.en: An algorithm is an executable method or sequence of steps. Model training follows algorithms, but an algorithm is not itself the resulting trained model.

example.zh: 本题规则R1：数量达到10（含10）转人工复核，否则直接流转。它是固定规则演练，不是通用审批政策。相同输入和规则版本应可重复；改输入可能改动作。
example.en: Exercise rule R1: quantities at least 10 go to human review; lower quantities proceed. This is an exercise rule, not a general approval policy. Identical input and version should reproduce results; changing input may change the action.

instructions.zh: 选择输入和预计动作再运行。对同一输入重跑，之后检查9和10两侧，并根据记录说明结论。
instructions.en: Choose an input and expected action, then run. Repeat an identical input, test 9 and 10, then conclude from the records.

explanation.zh: 算法是一套可执行的方法或步骤。模型训练也依照算法进行，但算法本身不是训练后得到的模型。
explanation.en: An algorithm is an executable method or sequence of steps. Model training follows algorithms, but an algorithm is not itself the resulting trained model.

evidence.quote: A clearly specified mathematical process for computation; a set of rules that, if followed, will give a prescribed result.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

explanation.zh: 规则系统把明确条件映射到动作。同一输入和规则版本应产生同一结果，适合固定阈值、必填校验和明确审批政策。
explanation.en: A rule-based system maps explicit conditions to actions. The same input and rule version should yield the same result, making it suitable for fixed thresholds, required-field checks and explicit approval policies.

evidence.quote: A clearly specified mathematical process for computation; a set of rules that, if followed, will give a prescribed result.
all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.

text.zh: 相同输入和规则版本，结果可重复
text.en: Same input and rule version reproduce the result

text.zh: 输入怎样变，输出都必须一样
text.en: Output must stay identical for every input

text.zh: 多运行几次就自动从样本学习
text.en: Repeated runs automatically learn from examples

boundary.zh: 本次观察只验证给定输入和R1规则，不能据此断言所有AI都不变或已发生学习。
boundary.en: These observations concern the given inputs and rule R1; they do not prove all AI is invariant or that learning occurred.

title.zh: 参数实验台：使用与学习

goal.zh: 亲自使用模型、用核验样本改变参数，再用新输入检查使用过程，区分训练与推理。
goal.en: Use a model, change its parameter with a verified example, then try a new input and distinguish training from inference.

explanation.zh: 训练利用已有样本调整模型参数，使模型学习数据中的模式。训练效果好不代表对新数据一定表现好，需要独立验证。
explanation.en: Training uses existing examples to adjust model parameters so the model learns patterns in data. Good training performance does not guarantee good performance on new data; independent validation is needed.

example.zh: 本题简化模型：输出=参数×输入，初始参数2。核验样本输入2、真实结果8。使用模型不改变参数；学习按钮按本题样本拟合参数。一次拟合演练不代表所有模型都这样训练。
example.en: Toy model: output = parameter × input, initially parameter 2. A verified example has input 2 and outcome 8. Using the model leaves the parameter unchanged; the learning button fits this example. This one-step exercise is not a universal training process.

instructions.zh: 先用初始模型试输入；再用核验样本学习；换个输入使用学后的模型；根据实际记录判断哪次改变了参数。
instructions.en: Try the initial model, learn from the verified example, use the fitted model on a different input, then judge which recorded operation changed parameters.

explanation.zh: 训练利用已有样本调整模型参数，使模型学习数据中的模式。训练效果好不代表对新数据一定表现好，需要独立验证。
explanation.en: Training uses existing examples to adjust model parameters so the model learns patterns in data. Good training performance does not guarantee good performance on new data; independent validation is needed.

evidence.quote: In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 推理是使用已训练的模型处理新输入。训练改变参数；推理通常使用已有参数产生预测或生成内容。
explanation.en: Inference uses a trained model to process new inputs. Training changes parameters; inference usually uses existing parameters to produce predictions or generated content.

evidence.quote: AI inference is the act of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

text.zh: 训练：利用样本改变参数

boundary.zh: 这里只演示单参数与显式核验样本；输出正确不等于真实业务已验证，训练演练通过不代表泛化已经证明。
boundary.en: This demonstrates one parameter and a verified example. Correct toy outputs do not validate a real use or establish generalization.
